title: Test plan
description: The out.json an AI Planner writes into its run workspace. Validated before anything else reads it, so a malformed model response fails at the boundary with a field path instead of halfway through execution.

sourceAppMapRunId.description: Which run produced the application map this plan was written against. A plan built on a stale map is still reproducible, but it is knowably stale.

rationale.description: Why these cases and not others. Model prose, shown to a human reviewer, never parsed.

coverageNotes.description: What the plan does not cover, and why.
